calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_period <= 3
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.region,
  s.format,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_sales,
  MIN(f.sale_date) as min_date,
  MAX(f.sale_date) as max_date
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.fiscal_period
LIMIT 15

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.region,
  s.format,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 2
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  r.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  r.closure_type,
  r.closure_start_date,
  r.closure_end_date,
  r.weeks_closed
FROM ref_store_closure r
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
WHERE (r.closure_start_date <= '2026-06-28' AND r.closure_end_date >= '2026-06-01')
  OR (r.closure_start_date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-28')
ORDER BY r.closure_start_date
